ways.label: Angelus Hut via Mt Cedric Track/Route

start.name: Sabine Hut
start.quote: The track begins behind Sabine Hut

evidence: This is a very steep route to the Angelus basin which is exposed above the bush edge.
The track begins behind Sabine Hut and climbs very steeply and steadily to the bush edge.
Poles and cairns mark the route from here, which eventually drops off the eastern side of a high ridge of Mt Cedric (1,532 m) and onto Rotomaninitua/Lake Angelus.

doubts: The text never states that the route ends at Angelus Hut in the description; it is taken from the page name, the one-way distance and the side trips 'from Angelus Hut'. The text says the route drops onto Lake Angelus. Sabine Hut is the start (track begins behind it), listed as a hut at the start.
